camel_example: aliyun sas UpgradeHoneypotNode --region cn-hangzhou --AllowHoneypotAccessInternet true --NodeId 'a882e590-b87b-45a6-87b9-d0a3e5a00000' --Lang zh
description_en: Upgrades the version of a specified honeypot management node
description_zh: 升级指定蜜罐管理节点的版本
kebab_example: aliyun sas upgrade-honeypot-node --allow-honeypot-access-internet true --node-id a882e590-b87b-45a6-87b9-d0a3e5a00000 --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpgradeHoneypotNode

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow the honeypot to access the Internet. Valid values:
true: Allowed.
false: Not allowed
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许蜜罐访问外网。取值：
true：允许
false：不允许
parameters.name: allow_honeypot_access_internet

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the management node to upgrade.
You can call the [ListHoneypotNode](~~ListHoneypotNode~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要升级的管理节点ID。
调用[ListHoneypotNode](~~ListHoneypotNode~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang
